subject: science
name: Science
title: Grade 12 Science: Environmental Science
overview: Grade 12 Science provides collegiate-level scientific inquiry across chemical, physical, and environmental systems aligned with Next Generation Science Standards (NGSS).
competencies: Design empirical laboratory investigations, analyze complex data sets, and account for experimental error.
Model atomic, molecular, physical, and ecological systems using mathematical and conceptual tools.
Apply scientific principles to solve technological and ecological problems through engineering design.
Evaluate the ethical, societal, and environmental consequences of scientific discoveries.

modules.title: Earth Systems, Atmospheric Chemistry & Biogeochemical Cycles
modules.description: Investigating atmospheric layers, greenhouse gas absorption, ocean acidification, and carbon/nitrogen geochemical balances.

topics.title: Atmospheric Dynamics, Ozone and the Greenhouse Effect
topics.description: Modeling solar radiation balance, stratospheric ozone depletion, and infrared thermal trapping.

topics.title: Ocean Acidification and Marine Carbon Sinks
topics.description: Investigating chemical equilibria of dissolved CO2, carbonic acid, and calcium carbonate coral decay.

modules.title: Population Ecology, Biodiversity & Conservation Biology
modules.description: Analyzing carrying capacity models, habitat fragmentation, endangered species recovery plans, and biodiversity indices.

topics.title: Demographic Modeling and Limiting Factors
topics.description: Applying demographic transition models, age structure diagrams, and r-selected vs. K-selected species.

topics.title: Conservation Strategies and Ecosystem Restoration
topics.description: Designing wildlife corridors, marine protected areas, and evaluated captive breeding programs.

modules.title: Energy Resources, Environmental Engineering & Sustainability
modules.description: Evaluating fossil fuels, nuclear fission, renewable solar/wind/geothermal systems, and water purification technologies.

topics.title: Conventional vs. Renewable Energy Portfolios
topics.description: Conducting life-cycle energy analyses comparing coal/natural gas emissions against solar/wind efficiency.

topics.title: Sustainable Urban Planning and Circular Economy
topics.description: Engineering green infrastructure, zero-waste composting, water treatment facilities, and smart grid systems.
